contract.series: csv[slot] alternates (keepa minutes, value); slot 18 (buy box) uses (minutes, price, shipping) triples
contract.unavailable: a negative value (-1, -2) marks a span with no offer from that moment

oracle.method: the donor's two modules transpiled with ECDEV's TypeScript compiler and run unmodified; 12 decodeHistory cases (pairs, -1/-2, buy-box triples, trailing incomplete sample, date range, random series of 10 to 400 points) and 5 keepaTimeToDate cases

parity: ECDEV's available points equal the donor's (same instants to the day, same values) wherever the donor did not downsample; where it did, every donor point is one of ECDEV's

divergence.why: dropping them stretches the previous price across stock-outs, inflating availability and hiding stock-out discounts
evenly spaced indices drop short promotions and bias time-weighted statistics
several changes per day collapse into one date

native: adapter/keepa/src/client.rs::external_history (wired into normalize, the KEEPA layer of product.analyze)

evidence_typing.price: EXTERNAL_HISTORY: provider claims beside ECDEV's own watch facts, never merged into them
evidence_typing.sales_rank: EXTERNAL_HISTORY + DEMAND_PROXY, meaning SALES_RANK_NOT_SALES; no sales estimate

credentials: none needed for fixtures and the oracle; live Keepa acquisition stays opt-in, paid and disabled by the default budget
not_done: seller-count, offer-count and rating history slots
use of these metrics in shortlist decisions: they are reported beside the product, not scored
